repositoryCreate.name: program-kit-evidence
repositoryCreate.description: Reviewed, bounded repair evidence for Program Kit consumer reports. Contract validation is not independent reproduction.

appRegistrationReview.name: Program Kit Evidence Guardian
appRegistrationReview.visibility: public identity/permission inspection; no Marketplace listing
appRegistrationReview.otherAccounts: Public registration permits other accounts to install it; no webhook/service is provided and no authority over their repositories is used. The orbyss-io installation selects only program-kit-evidence.

allowedPostApprovalSubstitutions.ruleset.rules.required_status_checks.int: positive ID of the exact approved organization-owned App
allowedPostApprovalSubstitutions.guardian-deployment.json.repositoryRules: positive ID returned by creation of the reviewed repository ruleset
allowedPostApprovalSubstitutions.environment.GUARDIAN_APP_CLIENT_ID: client ID of that same App

stopConditions: Repository or App slug already exists with different ownership/content
Requested permissions, secret scope, branch protections or action pins differ
Private key would be exposed to logs/chat/files in the public tree
A public operational test needs evidence content not separately reviewed
operationOrder: Approve exact source inventory and this setup
Create empty public repository and register/install the approved App on this repository only
Publish reviewed seed source as main and record its exact commit
Configure main-only environment, enter App private key directly in GitHub, and set the two variables
Apply reviewed Actions permissions; create the reviewed App-bound repository ruleset initially disabled to obtain its ID
Publish only substituted deployment metadata, then activate the exact reviewed ruleset without bypass; no submission availability until activation and acceptance
Read back administrative environment/installation/secret scope and effective main rules; run read-only verifier
Separately review synthetic valid, rejected and same-name-forgery operational PRs before public testing; dispatch from main; verify checks are from the approved App and rules block failures
Enable the documented consumer route only after operational acceptance
authorityLimits: No changes to Program Kit main or releases
No paid agents, subscription changes or external hosting
initialRulesetEnforcement: disabled during unadvertised setup; activate exact reviewed rules after deployment metadata is committed

deploymentConfiguration.repositoryRulesetId: <positive ID returned for the reviewed ruleset>
deploymentConfiguration.githubAppId: <positive ID of the approved dedicated App>
